stop_rule: Stop each conversation on runtime error or pending owner input; keep all attempted turns, no replacement successes.
summary_validation: Keep strict schema and grounded memory validation.
measurement: End-to-end run_turn wall time plus five inclusive trace phases; report post-tool final and ask_user separately.
exclusions: No first-card latency inferred from synchronous capture; no claim about production traffic or successful matching worker without execution.
